visual_anchor_inventory.description: White/cream ram (Aries) in center of composition, facing left. Body is pale cream/white parchment tone with faint brown ink outlines. Black ink label beneath reads 'ohárd' (transcribed). Occupies central circle.

Outermost circular text band running full 360° around composition. Text written in brown/reddish-brown ink, running counter-clockwise (or clockwise—radial orientation). Contains f71r.1 @Cc long inscription.
Second concentric ring text band, inside the nymph ring. Contains f71r.12 @Cc inscription.
Innermost concentric text ring closest to the central Aries figure. Contains f71r.18 @Cc inscription.
Ring of 15 nymph figures arranged equidistantly around the central Aries, each associated with a zodiac label. Figures are clothed; garments show red/brown, blue-green, and green pigmentation.
Gold/yellow 6-8 pointed stars interspersed between nymph figures and in outer ring. Approximately 10 visible stars.
Nymph at top-center (12 o'clock position). Standing in tub/barrel. Red-brown torso, light skirt. Holding star aloft with right hand.
Nymph at ~1 o'clock. Seated/standing, red garment, holding object. Blue-tinted skirt/lower garment.
Nymph at ~2 o'clock. Green lower garment, red upper. Standing posture.
Nymph at ~3 o'clock (right side). Red-brown garment. Holding item. Gold star nearby.
Nymph at ~4-5 o'clock. Blue-green lower garment, red-brown upper. Squatting/seated posture.
Nymph at ~5 o'clock. Green garment. Star to the left. Seated.
Nymph at ~6 o'clock (bottom center). Blue lower garment (prominent cobalt blue tub/skirt). Red-brown upper. Gold star to right.
Nymph at ~7 o'clock. Green lower garment, red-brown upper. Standing.
Nymph at ~8 o'clock. Blue-green tub/barrel. Red upper garment. Star visible.
Nymph at ~9 o'clock (left side). Multi-color garment: blue checkerboard/patterned lower half, red upper. Star to left. Most elaborately dressed.
Nymph at ~10 o'clock. Green lower, red-brown upper. Star nearby.
Nymph at ~11 o'clock. Red upper, green lower skirt. Holding star.
Gold 8-pointed star at upper-left quadrant, outside nymph ring in outer text band zone.
Gold 8-pointed star, upper-right quadrant outer zone.
Reddish-colored 6-pointed star in inner ring area, right side (~2 o'clock inner position).
Reddish star, inner ring left side (~9-10 o'clock inner position).
Short black-ink label directly beneath the Aries ram in the central open space. Likely 'ohárd' or similar — the central zodiac identifier.

visual_anchors.morphology_description: Aries ram depicted in profile facing left, occupying central circle of the composition. Body rendered in pale cream/unpigmented parchment with brown ink line work. Proportions are stylized, legs extended. A short black-ink label inscription sits below the belly of the animal. The ram appears to stand on undulating ground lines (green-tinted).

Outermost text ring: a continuous band of Voynich script running the full circumference (~360°) of the circular composition. Text flows radially/curved. The band sits between the page margin and the nymph figures. Written in reddish-brown ink, script is uniform size, densely packed. This band corresponds to the longest locus (f71r.1, @Cc).
Second concentric text ring, between the nymph figures (outer) and the innermost ring. Runs approximately 360° but may have small gaps where nymph figures intrude inward. Corresponds to f71r.12 @Cc.
Innermost concentric text ring immediately surrounding the central Aries figure. Shortest arc inscription (f71r.18 @Cc). Text flows curved/radial at close proximity to the animal figure.

Female figure standing in a circular tub or barrel at the 12-o'clock position. Upper body red-brown pigment; lower body/skirt pale cream. Right arm raised holding a gold multi-pointed star. Hair indicated by brown ink strokes. Tub is circular, brown outline.
Nymph at ~1 o'clock. Red upper garment, blue lower skirt/tub. Seated or semi-standing posture. Gold star to upper-left of figure.
Nymph at ~2 o'clock. Green lower garment, red-brown upper. Standing, arms at sides or slightly raised. No tub visible.
Nymph at 3-o'clock (rightmost). Red-brown garment. Gold star to the right side. Holding or gesturing toward the star.
Nymph at ~4-5 o'clock. Blue-green tub or lower skirt, red-brown torso. Seated posture.
Nymph at ~5 o'clock. Green garment. Gold star to the left. Seated or crouching.
Nymph at 6-o'clock (bottom). Most prominent blue garment — cobalt blue tub/skirt lower half, red-brown upper torso. Gold star to the right. The cobalt blue is the most saturated pigment on the folio.
Nymph at ~7 o'clock. Green lower, red-brown upper. Standing.
Nymph at ~8 o'clock. Blue-green barrel/tub. Red upper garment. Gold star nearby.

Nymph at 9-o'clock. Most elaborately dressed: lower garment has a blue-and-white checkerboard or grid pattern (suggesting a patterned textile). Red upper torso. Gold star to the far left. This nymph's checkerboard garment is visually unique on this folio.
Nymph at ~10 o'clock. Green lower skirt, red-brown upper. Gold star to left.
Nymph at ~11 o'clock. Red upper, green lower skirt. Holding or touching a star.
6-pointed star rendered in red ink, located in the inner ring zone at approximately 2 o'clock. Red stars may indicate a specific astrological or calendrical marker distinct from gold stars.
6-pointed red star in inner ring zone at approximately 10 o'clock. Counterpart to the red star on the right.
Short black-ink label below the Aries ram's belly. Likely the zodiac sign identifier. Rendered in darker ink than surrounding brown text, suggesting special status or later addition.

text_blocks_mapping.description: Outermost circular inscription running the full circumference of the composition. This is the longest single locus on the folio (@Cc type = inside/on concentric circle ring). Text flows radially curved following the outer ring path. No bisection (<->) markers present.

lines.interaction: Text runs along the outermost ink circle, curved to follow the ring geometry. Starts approximately at the top (12 o'clock), proceeds clockwise. The text band is approximately 30-40 px wide (normalized). No <-> bisection. The nymph figures at positions 1-12 o'clock interrupt the visual flow but the text likely flows continuously in the band OUTSIDE the nymph ring. At top-center the nymph_01_top_center figure is directly adjacent to this ring band.

text_blocks_mapping.description: Second concentric ring inscription. Shorter than the outer ring. Runs approximately 360° in the inner band between the nymph figures and the innermost ring. @Cc type.

lines.interaction: Text follows the second ring path. Positioned between the nymph figures (outer) and the innermost ring (inner). Nymph figures may partially overlap this ring at their feet/lower bodies. The text circles the central Aries figure at medium distance. No <-> bisection detected.

text_blocks_mapping.description: Innermost concentric ring text, closest to the central Aries ram. Shortest ring inscription. @Cc type. Directly frames the central figure.

lines.interaction: This innermost inscription tightly encircles the Aries ram. It is possible this is a partial arc rather than a full ring, as only 10 words are present — insufficient to fill 360°. Most likely occupies the upper semicircle (180°) or is distributed in two arcs (upper and lower). The central_aries_ram anchor is the visual element immediately inside this ring. No <-> bisection.

semantic_notes.structure: Three concentric text rings + one ring of nymph figures (~12-15 figures) + central Aries ram + scattered stars

color_significance.cobalt_blue_garments: 3-4 nymphs have prominent blue tub/skirt elements (nymph_07, nymph_09, nymph_10). Blue may encode water/liquid state per semantic grounding hypothesis.
color_significance.green_garments: Multiple nymphs with green lower garments (nymph_03, nymph_06, nymph_08, nymph_11, nymph_12). Green may encode plant/herbal or dry-powder state.
color_significance.red_brown_garments: Most common upper garment color across all nymphs. May indicate a neutral or active-preparation state.
color_significance.red_stars_vs_gold_stars: Red ink stars (2 identified, inner ring at ~2 and ~10 o'clock) versus gold/yellow stars (outer ring, ~10 identified). Red stars may mark specific calendar positions or degree markers for Aries.
color_significance.checkerboard_nymph_10: The grid-patterned garment of nymph_10 at 9 o'clock is unique; may indicate a transition point or specific degree.

label_morphology.all_nymph_labels_begin_with_ot_ok_prefix: Loci 2-11 and 13-17 all produce labels starting with 'ot-' or 'ok-' prefix clusters. This is consistent with the hypothesis that these prefixes encode specific material or ritual states associated with each zodiac degree.
label_morphology.inner_ring_labels_longer: The @Cc ring texts (f71r.1, f71r.12, f71r.18) are denser and longer, suggesting systematic zodiacal enumeration rather than isolated identifiers.
label_morphology.no_bisections: Complete absence of <-> bisection markers confirms this folio has no plant stems or crossing objects interrupting text — consistent with a pure cosmological/zodiac folio format.
